infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LocalLink needs your location to show nearby experiences and enable GPS tracking during tours.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: LocalLink needs your location for live GPS tracking during experiences for your safety.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LocalLink needs camera access to take photos during your experiences.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LocalLink needs photo library access to upload photos for reviews and profile.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LocalLink needs microphone access for voice calls with guides.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow LocalLink to use your location for GPS tracking during experiences.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow LocalLink to access your photos for profile and reviews.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow LocalLink to take photos during experiences.
